responsibility: Render independent awakening preferences, notification delivery, staged location authorization and honest HealthKit request/data availability. Opening the surface is read-only; Task 4.0f owns production orchestration.

inputs.authorization: Notification settings snapshot; location notDetermined/WhenInUse/Always/denied/restricted; HealthKit request lifecycle plus actual HRV sample availability (never inferred read granted/denied)
inputs.settings: SQLite-backed independent geofence, emotion and anniversary preferences, notification-delivery intent, and HealthKit request lifecycle; system authorization snapshots remain live-only
inputs.runtimeStatus: Loading, error and unavailable states from the UI adapter

outputs.visibleContent: Apple-native grouped permission and awakening-setting controls with shared status/action hierarchy
outputs.interactionTargets: Notification opt-in requests notification only; geofence enable requests When In Use only and a separate background action may request Always; emotion enable requests HRV read only; anniversary enable requests no system permission. Notification denial limits system delivery but not in-app cards.
outputs.accessibilityTree: Form reading order with stable labels, values, hints and permission status

fallbackConditions: Masonry is always forbidden for this Task surface
Opening or re-entering the surface reads snapshots and never triggers a prompt
Notification denial disables system delivery only; awakening preferences and in-app cards remain available
HealthKit UI never claims read granted/denied and falls back when no readable samples exist
description: Awakening delivery settings — notification, location, health permissions and geofence/emotion/anniversary toggles
